mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comments (comment_no, board_no, member_no, content, created_at, delete_yn) VALUES (comments_seq.nextval, #{boardNo}, #{memberNo}, #{content}, SYSTIMESTAMP, 'N')
mapper.select: SELECT comment_no AS commentNo, board_no AS boardNo, member_no AS memberNo, content, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, delete_yn AS deleteYn FROM comments WHERE board_no = #{boardNo} AND delete_yn = 'N' ORDER BY created_at ASC
